messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 100 words based on these AI agents headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: AI agents are rapidly transitioning from experimental phases into real-world production environments. Open-source agent frameworks are hitting a major milestone as adoption triples across the tech industry. Meanwhile, startups are quietly replacing traditional hand-coded orchestration with more flexible, model-driven agents. In the competitive landscape, tool-calling reliability has emerged as the critical new benchmark for evaluating frontier models. Additionally, multi-agent swarms are moving beyond simple demonstrations to power complex, regulated enterprise workflows. To support this widespread deployment, new observability standards are finally emerging, enabling developers to trace agent decisions end to end with greater confidence.
